_comment: Z1 forest tank (content pass C2): slow, heavy, and it RAGES — BearSwipe's berserker modifier makes a half-dead bear roughly half again as dangerous, punishing the slow facetank grind. curveLevel 4 = a deep-forest fight. Drops the defense passive (ThickHide) and its own rage as a player aura. All values [PLACEHOLDER] ⚑ NUMBERS REWRITE C2d (D4): partial resistances. Before this pass resistances existed ONLY as lock-and-key gates ({"*": 0, "harvest": 1}) — never as mitigation — so every hit in the game landed for full and a damage type meant nothing. These are the curated set that gives the type axis teeth: thick winter fur. Deliberately NON-physical — the C8 tier-threshold guardrail drives its bot with authored Damage at L1, which is physical, so a physical entry here would silently move a calibration this pass has no business moving. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
